name: lotka-volterra
title: Lotka-Volterra predator-prey (simbio)
question: Driven as a process-bigraph process, does simbio integrate a Lotka-Volterra Antimony model into sustained, bounded predator-prey oscillations?
hypothesis: Integrating the predator-prey reaction network (prey birth, predation, predator death, predator reproduction) through simbio yields both species staying strictly positive and the prey oscillating with repeated peaks over t in [0, 40].
objective: Demonstrate end to end that pbg_simbio.composites.crn.simbio_lotka_volterra runs the real simbio ODE engine and emits correct species trajectories, with simbio acting as a pluggable process-bigraph process.
description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-simbio. A Lotka-Volterra Antimony model is integrated by SimbioProcess against shared concentration/parameter stores and emitted each tick. Over t in [0, 40] (161 rows), prey ranges 0.506-13.59 and predator 0.916-6.16, both strictly positive, with 3 prey peaks above 5.0 — the textbook boom-and-bust oscillation.

expected_behavior.name: sustained-oscillation
expected_behavior.en: Both populations stay positive and the prey oscillates — at least two prey peaks above 5.0 over the run (sustained cycles, not monotone decay or a fixed point).
expected_behavior.rationale: The Lotka-Volterra system has a neutrally stable cycle around its coexistence equilibrium, so a correct integration gives bounded, repeating oscillations with both species strictly positive.

behavior_tests.name: sustained-oscillation
behavior_tests.description: >= 2 prey peaks above 5.0 over t in [0,40], with prey_min and pred_min > 0 (observed 3 prey peaks; prey_min = 0.506, pred_min = 0.916).

findings.name: bounded-predator-prey-cycles
findings.statement: simbio integrates the Lotka-Volterra model to a bounded oscillation: prey 0.506-13.59, predator 0.916-6.16 over t in [0, 40], both strictly positive, with 3 prey peaks above 5.0.
findings.provenance: Observed in an isolated-venv run of the lotka_volterra composite on pbg-simbio @ main (commit c43ecf0) / simbio 1.1.0, 2026-11-27 (reproduced by sims/run.py).

conclusion: PASS. Run as a process-bigraph process, simbio integrated the Lotka-Volterra predator-prey network into a sustained, bounded oscillation (3 prey peaks; both species strictly positive). simbio behaves as a drop-in process-bigraph CRN/ODE engine, emitting real species trajectories.

derived.insight: simbio integrates the Lotka-Volterra model to a bounded oscillation: prey 0.506-13.59, predator 0.916-6.16 over t in [0, 40], both strictly positive, with 3 prey peaks above 5.0.
